plan.notes: Transfer-oriented AA semester-by-semester pathway as published in Dallas College's official Guided Pathways (GPS) system; source page states 'This is not an official degree plan. See catalog for official degree requirements.' and 'This guided pathway prepares you to transfer to a university to earn a bachelor's degree in Kinesiology.' The catalog's generic AA degree rule (42-hour Core Curriculum + 18 additional elective hours) does not publish a semester-by-semester course list, so this official 2025-2026 AA transfer pathway is used instead of a synthesized 'general' plan. Core component codes (CB010 etc.) printed verbatim on the source page. 'Must earn a grade of C or higher' rules on ENGL 1301 and MATH 1342 are graduation requirements stated on the page, not course prereqs. catalog.dallascollege.edu direct fetches returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher, so the official catalog program page could not be read directly; the linked official catalog domain page is cited as the authoritative requirements source.
